summary: Backend-only verification of the new Share a Moment feature. All 38 tests pass across 5 areas: (1) public/member moment CRUD + like/comment/report, (2) mobile admin /api/admin/moments gate + list, (3) CMS /api/cms/moments list/detail/action/delete with exclusive Featured semantics, (4) George navigate whitelist (moments in, recipes out, recipes alias → moments) plus a live smoke test of /api/mcgs/george/event/start with current_screen='moments' (no 5xx), and (5) regression: /api/recipes still responds and /api/moments/featured route order does not clash with /api/moments/{id}. Confirmed +8 butterfly points awarded on create via the new award_points call. No blocking bugs found in the moments feature.

minor.issue: server.py:8149 still calls _award_points(...) (undefined name) inside a bare try/except, so the recipe author silently misses their 8 points. Recipes UI is being retired but the endpoint is still live. Change to `await award_points(body.user_id, 8, reason='recipe_shared')` or delete the recipes routes entirely.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace the remaining `_award_points(...)` call at /app/backend/server.py:8149 (create_recipe) with `award_points(...)` — currently silently swallowed and recipe authors get 0 points.
No other backend action required for Share a Moment; feature is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering is correct: /api/moments/featured is defined at server.py:8393 BEFORE /api/moments/{moment_id} at 8412 — no clash.
Privacy gate _viewer_can_see_moment correctly hides hidden moments from non-admins and friends-only moments from non-friends; verified via 403 & list-filter tests.

Feature exclusivity is enforced in BOTH /api/admin/moments/{id}/action (server.py:8669) and /api/cms/moments/{id}/action (cms_module.py:2258) — feature clears any previously featured moment. Verified end-to-end.
Report de-dup uses reports.user_id (server.py:8597) — idempotent per user per moment. Verified.

George's _NAVIGATE_KEYS whitelists 'moments' and drops 'recipes' (service.py:1411-1415); the alias table maps 'recipe'/'recipes' → 'moments' so any stale George prompt still lands the member on the current feature.
seed_data_creation: Every test-created user, moment, comment, and report is prefixed with TEST_ or TESTmom_ for easy cleanup. No permanent data pollution beyond that.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_moments.py is the canonical regression suite for the Share a Moment feature. It creates fresh members via /api/auth/signup and resolves the admin user_id via /api/auth/demo-login (maggie). CMS admin login uses hello@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!. Frontend was NOT tested per the review request; when frontend testing is required, cover /moments feed, /moments/new composer (500-char cap, 6-photo cap, privacy toggle), /moments/[id] detail (like/comment/report/delete), Home hero + Moment of the Week banner, and the /admin/moments Mission Control page in the website (Next.js).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in the Share a Moment code path. The only pre-existing minor issue (recipes _award_points typo) is unrelated to this session's work and is silently swallowed by the try/except wrapper.
